texts.hos.9.6: Porque, eis que elles se foram por causa da destruição: o Egypto os recolherá, Memphis os sepultará: o desejavel da sua prata as ortigas o possuirão por herança, espinhos haverá nas suas moradas.
texts.hos.9.7: Já chegaram os dias da visitação, já chegaram os dias da retribuição; os de Israel o saberão: o propheta é louco, o homem de espirito é furioso; por causa da abundancia da tua iniquidade tambem abundará o odio.
texts.hos.9.8: Ephraim era o vigia com o meu Deus, mas o propheta é como um laço de caçador de aves em todos os seus caminhos, odio na casa do seu Deus.
texts.hos.9.9: Mui profundamente se corromperam, como nos dias de Gibeah: lembrar-se-ha das suas injustiças, visitará os peccados d’elles.
texts.hos.9.10: Achei a Israel como uvas no deserto, vi a vossos paes como a fructa temporã da figueira no seu principio; porém entraram a Baalpeor, e se apartaram para essa vergonha, e se tornaram abominaveis como aquillo que amaram.
texts.hos.9.11: Quanto a Ephraim, a sua gloria como ave voará desde o nascimento, e desde o ventre, e desde o concebimento.
texts.hos.9.12: Ainda que venham a crear seus filhos, comtudo os privarei d’elles d’entre os homens, porque tambem, ai d’elles! quando me apartar d’elles.
texts.hos.9.13: Ephraim, assim como vi a Tyro, plantada está n’um logar deleitoso; mas Ephraim tirará para fóra seus filhos para o matador.
texts.hos.9.14: Dá-lhes, ó Senhor; que pois lhes darás? dá-lhes uma madre que aborte e seios seccos.
texts.hos.9.15: Toda a sua malicia se acha em Gilgal, porque ali os aborreci pela malicia das suas obras: lançal-os-hei para fóra de minha casa; não os amarei mais: todos os seus principes são rebeldes.
texts.hos.9.16: Ephraim foi ferido, seccou-se a sua raiz; não darão fructo: e, ainda que gerem, todavia matarei os desejaveis do seu ventre.
texts.hos.9.17: O meu Deus os rejeitará, porque não o ouvem, e vagabundos andarão entre as nações.
texts.hos.10.1: Israel é uma vide vasia; dá fructo para si mesmo: segundo a multidão do seu fructo, multiplicou os altares, segundo a bondade da sua terra, fizeram boas as estatuas.
texts.hos.10.2: Lisonjeia-os o seu coração, agora serão culpados: cortará os seus altares, e destruirá as suas estatuas.
texts.hos.10.3: Porque agora dirão: Não temos rei, porque não tememos ao Senhor: que, pois, nos faria o rei?
texts.hos.10.4: Fallaram palavras, jurando falsamente, fazendo um concerto: e florescerá o juizo como herva peçonhenta nos regos dos campos.
texts.hos.10.5: Os moradores de Samaria serão atemorisados pelo bezerro de Beth-aven; porque o seu povo lamentará por causa d’elle, como tambem os seus sacerdotes (que por causa d’elle se alegravam), por causa da sua gloria, que pois se foi d’ella.
texts.hos.10.6: Tambem a Assyria será levada como um presente ao rei Jareb: Ephraim ficará confuso, e Israel se envergonhará por causa do seu conselho.
texts.hos.10.7: O rei de Samaria será cortado como a escuma sobre a face da agua.
texts.hos.10.8: E os altos de Aven, peccado de Israel, serão destruidos: espinhos e cardos crescerão sobre os seus altares; e dirão aos montes: Cobri-nos! e aos outeiros: Cahi sobre nós!
texts.hos.10.9: Desde os dias de Gibeah peccaste, ó Israel; ali pararam: a peleja em Gibeah contra os filhos da perversidade não os accommetterá.
texts.hos.10.10: Eu os castigarei á medida do meu desejo; e congregar-se-hão contra elles os povos, quando os atar nos seus dois regos.
texts.hos.10.11: Porque Ephraim é uma bezerra acostumada, que gosta de trilhar; passei sobre a formosura do seu pescoço: porventura deixarei andar a cavallo Ephraim? Judah lavrará, Jacob lhe desfará os torrões.
texts.hos.10.12: Semeae para vós a justiça, segae para beneficencia, e lavrae o campo de lavoura; porque o tempo é de buscar ao Senhor, até que venha e chova a justiça sobre vós.
texts.hos.10.13: Lavrastes a impiedade, segastes a perversidade, e comestes o fructo da mentira; porque confiaste no teu caminho, na multidão dos teus valentes.
texts.hos.10.14: Portanto, entre os seus povos se levantará um grande tumulto, e todas as tuas fortalezas serão destruidas, como Shalman destruiu a Beth-arbel no dia da guerra: a mãe ali foi despedaçada com os filhos.
texts.hos.10.15: Assim vos fará Beth-el, por causa da malicia de vossa malicia: o rei de Israel de madrugada será totalmente destruido.
texts.hos.11.1: Quando Israel era menino, eu o amei; e do Egypto chamei a meu filho.
texts.hos.11.2: Mas, como elles os chamavam, assim se iam da sua face: sacrificavam a baalins, e queimavam incenso ás imagens de esculptura.
texts.hos.11.3: Eu, todavia, ensinei a andar a Ephraim; tomei-os pelos seus braços, mas não conheceram que eu os curava.
texts.hos.11.5: Não voltará para a terra do Egypto, mas a Assyria será seu rei; porque recusam converter-se.
texts.hos.11.4: Attrahi-os com cordas humanas, com cordas de amor, e fui para elles como os que levantam o jugo de sobre as suas queixadas, e lhe dei mantimento.
texts.hos.11.6: E ficará a espada sobre as suas cidades, e consumirá os seus ferrolhos, e devorará, por causa dos seus conselhos.
texts.hos.11.7: Porque o meu povo se inclina a desviar-se de mim; bem que chamam ao Altissimo, nenhum d’elles se levanta.
texts.hos.11.8: Como te deixaria, ó Ephraim? como te entregaria, ó Israel? como te faria como Adama? te poria como Zeboim? Virou-se em mim o meu coração, todos os meus pezares juntamente estão accendidos.
texts.hos.11.9: Não executarei o furor da minha ira: não me tornarei para destruir a Ephraim, porque eu sou Deus e não homem, o Sancto no meio de ti, e não entrarei na cidade.
texts.hos.11.10: Andarão após o Senhor, elle bramará como leão: bramando pois elle, os filhos do occidente tremerão.
texts.hos.11.11: Tremendo, se achegarão como um passarinho os do Egypto, e como uma pomba os da terra da Assyria, e os farei habitar em suas casas, diz o Senhor.
texts.hos.11.12: Ephraim me cercou com mentira, e a casa de Israel com engano; mas Judah ainda domina com Deus, e com os sanctos está fiel.
texts.hos.12.1: Ephraim se apascenta de vento, e segue o vento leste: todo o dia multiplica a mentira e a destruição; e fazem alliança com a Assyria, e o azeite se leva ao Egypto.
texts.hos.12.2: O Senhor tambem com Judah tem contenda, e fará visitação sobre Jacob segundo os seus caminhos; segundo as suas obras lhe recompensará.
texts.hos.12.3: No ventre pegou do calcanhar de seu irmão, e pela sua força como principe se houve com Deus.
texts.hos.12.4: Como principe se houve com o anjo, e prevaleceu; chorou, e lhe supplicou: em Beth-el o achou, e ali fallou comnosco,
texts.hos.12.5: A saber, o Senhor, o Deus dos Exercitos: o Senhor é o seu memorial.
texts.hos.12.6: Tu, pois, converte-te a teu Deus: guarda a beneficencia e o juizo, e em teu Deus espera sempre.
texts.hos.12.7: Na mão do mercador está uma balança enganosa; ama a oppressão.
texts.hos.12.8: Ainda diz Ephraim: Comtudo eu estou enriquecido, e tenho adquirido para mim grandes bens: em todo o meu trabalho não acharão em mim iniquidade alguma que seja peccado.
texts.hos.12.9: Mas eu sou o Senhor teu Deus desde a terra do Egypto: eu ainda te farei habitar em tendas, como nos dias do ajuntamento.
texts.hos.12.10: E fallarei aos prophetas, e multiplicarei a visão; e pelo ministerio dos prophetas proporei similes.
texts.hos.12.11: Porventura não é Gilead iniquidade? pura vaidade são: em Gilgal sacrificam bois: os seus altares como montões de pedras são nos regos dos campos.
texts.hos.12.12: Jacob fugiu para o campo da Syria, e Israel serviu por sua mulher, e por sua mulher guardou o gado.
texts.hos.12.13: Mas o Senhor por um propheta fez subir a Israel do Egypto, e por um propheta foi elle guardado.
texts.hos.12.14: Ephraim porém mui amargosamente o irou: portanto deixará ficar sobre elle o seu sangue, e o seu Senhor lhe recompensará o seu opprobrio.
texts.hos.13.1: Quando Ephraim fallava, tremia-se; foi exalçado em Israel; mas quando se fez culpado em Baal, então morreu.
texts.hos.13.2: E agora accumularam peccados sobre peccados, e da sua prata fizeram uma imagem de fundição, idolos segundo o seu entendimento, que todos são obra de artifices, dos quaes dizem: Os homens que sacrificam beijem os bezerros.
texts.hos.13.3: Por isso serão como a nuvem de manhã, e como orvalho da madrugada, que passa: como folhelho que a tempestade lança da eira, e como o fumo da chaminé.
texts.hos.13.4: Eu pois sou o Senhor teu Deus desde a terra do Egypto; portanto não reconhecerás outro Deus fóra de mim, porque não ha Salvador senão eu.
texts.hos.13.5: Eu te conheci no deserto, na terra mui secca.
texts.hos.13.6: Depois elles se fartaram á proporção do seu pasto; estando pois fartos, ensoberbeceu-se o seu coração, por isso se esqueceram de mim.
texts.hos.13.7: Portanto serei para elles como leão; como leopardo espiarei no caminho.
texts.hos.13.8: Como urso que tem perdido seus filhos, os encontrarei, lhes romperei as teias do seu coração, e ali os devorarei como leão; as feras do campo os despedaçarão.
texts.hos.13.9: Isso te lançou a perder, ó Israel, que te rebellaste contra mim, a saber, contra a tua ajuda.
texts.hos.13.10: Onde está agora o teu rei, para que te guarde em todas as tuas cidades? e os teus juizes, dos quaes disseste: Dá-me rei e principes?
texts.hos.13.11: Dei-te um rei na minha ira, e t’o tirarei no meu furor.
texts.hos.13.12: A iniquidade de Ephraim está atada, o seu peccado está enthesourado.
texts.hos.13.13: Dôres de mulher de parto lhe virão: elle é um filho insensato: porque não permanece o seu tempo na paridura.
texts.hos.13.14: Eu pois os remirei da violencia do inferno, e os resgatarei da morte: onde estão, ó morte, as tuas pestes? onde está ó inferno, a tua perdição? o arrependimento será escondido de meus olhos.
texts.hos.13.15: Ainda que elle dê fructo entre os irmãos, virá o vento leste, vento do Senhor, subindo do deserto, e seccar-se-ha a sua veia, e seccar-se-ha a sua fonte: elle saqueará o thesouro de todos os vasos desejaveis.
texts.hos.13.16: Samaria virá a ser deserta, porque se rebellou contra o seu Deus: cairão á espada, seus filhos serão despedaçados, e as suas gravidas serão fendidas pelo meio.
texts.hos.14.1: Converte-te, ó Israel, ao Senhor teu Deus; porque pelos teus peccados tens caido.
texts.hos.14.2: Tomae comvosco palavras, e convertei-vos ao Senhor: dizei-lhe: Tira toda a iniquidade, e recebe o bem; e pagaremos os bezerros dos nossos labios.
texts.hos.14.3: Não nos salvará a Assyria, não iremos montados em cavallos, e á obra das nossas mãos não diremos mais: Tu és o nosso Deus; porque por ti o orphão alcançará misericordia.
texts.hos.14.4: Eu sararei a sua perversão, eu voluntariamente os amarei; porque a minha ira se apartou d’elles.
texts.hos.14.5: Eu serei a Israel como orvalho, elle florescerá como o lirio, e espalhará as suas raizes como o Libano.
texts.hos.14.6: Estender-se-hão as suas vergonteas, e a sua gloria será como a da oliveira, e cheirará como o Libano.
texts.hos.14.7: Voltarão os que se assentarem debaixo da sua sombra; serão vivificados como o trigo, e florescerão como a vide; a sua memoria será como o vinho do Libano.
texts.hos.14.8: Ephraim então dirá: Que mais tenho eu com os idolos? eu o tenho ouvido, e olharei para elle: ser-lhe-hei como a faia verde: de mim é achado o teu fructo.
texts.hos.14.9: Quem é sabio, para que entenda estas coisas; quem é prudente, para que as saiba? porque os caminhos do Senhor são rectos, e os justos andarão n’elles, mas os transgressores cairão n’elles.

texts.hos.1.1: The word of the LORD that came to Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
texts.hos.1.2: The beginning of the word of the LORD by Hosea. And the LORD said to Hosea, Go take to thee a wife addicted to lewdness and children of lewdness; for the land hath committed great lewdness, departing from the LORD.
texts.hos.1.3: So he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; who conceived, and bore him a son.
texts.hos.1.4: And the LORD said to him, Call his name Jezreel; for yet a little while, and I will avenge the blood of Jezreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel.
texts.hos.1.5: And it shall come to pass at that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezreel.
texts.hos.1.6: And she conceived again, and bore a daughter. And God said to him, Call her name Lo-ruhamah: for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel; but I will utterly take them away.
texts.hos.1.7: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by the LORD their God, and will not save them by bow, nor by sword, nor by battle, by horses, nor by horsemen.
texts.hos.1.8: Now when she had weaned Lo-ruhamah, she conceived, and bore a son.
texts.hos.1.9: Then said God, Call his name Lo-ammi: for ye are not my people, and I will not be your God.
texts.hos.1.10: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea, which cannot be measured nor numbered; and it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said to them, Ye are not my people, there it shall be said to them, Ye are the sons of the living God.
texts.hos.1.11: Then shall the children of Judah and the children of Israel be assembled, and appoint themselves one head, and they shall come up from the land: for great shall be the day of Jezreel.
texts.hos.2.1: Say ye to your brethren, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ruhamah.
texts.hos.2.2: Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: let her therefore put away her prostitutions out of her sight, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
texts.hos.2.3: Lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her like a dry land, and kill her with thirst.
texts.hos.2.4: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they are the children of lewdness.
texts.hos.2.5: For their mother hath played the harlot: she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.
texts.hos.2.6: Therefore, behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns, and make a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
texts.hos.2.7: And she shall follow after her lovers, but she shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: then shall she say, I will go and return to my first husband; for then was it better with me than now.
texts.hos.2.8: For she did not know that I gave her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied her silver and gold, which they prepared for Baal.
texts.hos.2.9: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in its time, and my wine in its season, and I will recover my wool and my flax given to cover her nakedness.
texts.hos.2.10: And now will I disclose her lewdness in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of my hand.
texts.hos.2.11: I will also cause all her mirth to cease, her feast days, her new moons, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn feasts.
texts.hos.2.12: And I will destroy her vines and her fig-trees, of which she hath said, These are my rewards that my lovers have given me: and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.
texts.hos.2.13: And I will visit upon her the days of Baalim, in which she burned incense to them, and she decked herself with her ear-rings and her jewels, and she went after her lovers, and forgot me, saith the LORD.
texts.hos.2.14: Therefore, behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak comfortably to her.
texts.hos.2.15: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came from the land of Egypt.
texts.hos.2.16: And it shall be at that day, saith the LORD, that thou shalt call me Ishi; and shalt call me no more Baali.
texts.hos.2.17: For I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.
texts.hos.2.18: And in that day will I make a covenant for them with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven, and with the creeping animals of the ground: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle out of the earth, and will make them to lie down in safety.
texts.hos.2.19: And I will betroth thee to me for ever; yes, I will betroth thee to me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in loving-kindness, and in mercies.
texts.hos.2.20: I will even betroth thee to me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know the LORD.
texts.hos.2.21: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith the LORD, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;
texts.hos.2.22: And the earth shall hear the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jezreel.
texts.hos.2.23: And I will sow her to me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to them who were not my people, Thou art my people; and they shall say, Thou art my God.
texts.hos.3.1: Then said the LORD to me, Go yet, love a woman beloved by her friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the LORD towards the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.
texts.hos.3.2: So I bought her to me for fifteen pieces of silver, and for a homer of barley, and a half homer of barley:
texts.hos.3.3: And I said to her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for another man: so will I also be for thee.
texts.hos.3.4: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an image, and without an ephod, and without teraphim:
texts.hos.3.5: Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the LORD their God, and David their king; and shall fear the LORD and his goodness in the latter days.
texts.hos.4.1: Hear the word of the LORD, ye children of Israel: for the LORD hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land.
texts.hos.4.2: By swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, they break out, and blood toucheth blood.
texts.hos.4.3: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth in it shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yes, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
texts.hos.4.4: Yet let no man contend, nor reprove another: for thy people are as they that contend with the priest.
texts.hos.4.5: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.
texts.hos.4.6: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.
texts.hos.4.7: As they were increased, so they sinned against me: therefore will I change their glory into shame.
texts.hos.4.8: They eat up the sin of my people, and they set their heart on their iniquity.
texts.hos.4.9: And there shall be, like people, like priest: and I will punish them for their ways, and reward them their doings.
texts.hos.4.10: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall be guilty of lewdness, and shall not increase: because they have ceased to take heed to the LORD.
texts.hos.4.11: Lewdness and wine and new wine take away the heart.
texts.hos.4.12: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth to them: for the spirit of lewdness hath caused them to err, and they have gone astray from under their God.
texts.hos.4.13: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shade of them is agreeable: therefore your daughters shall be guilty of lewdness, and your spouses shall commit adultery.
texts.hos.4.14: I will not punish your daughters when they are guilty of lewdness, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for they themselves are separated with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people that doth not understand shall fall.
texts.hos.4.15: Though thou, Israel, playest the harlot, yet let not Judah offend; and come not ye to Gilgal, neither go ye up to Beth-aven, nor swear, The LORD liveth.
texts.hos.4.16: For Israel slideth back as a backsliding heifer: now the LORD will feed them as a lamb in a large place.
texts.hos.4.17: Ephraim is joined to idols: let him alone.
texts.hos.4.18: Their drink is sour: they have been guilty of lewd deeds continually: her rulers with shame do love, Give ye.
texts.hos.4.19: The wind hath bound her up in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
texts.hos.5.1: Hear ye this, O priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ye ear, O house of the king; for judgment is towards you, because ye have been a snare on Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
texts.hos.5.2: And the revolters are profound to make slaughter, though I have been a rebuker of them all.
texts.hos.5.3: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me: for now, O Ephraim, thou art guilty of lewdness, and Israel is defiled.
texts.hos.5.4: They will not frame their doings to turn to their God: for the spirit of lewdness is in the midst of them, and they have not known the LORD.
texts.hos.5.5: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.
texts.hos.5.6: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek the LORD; but they shall not find him; he hath withdrawn himself from them.
texts.hos.5.7: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.
texts.hos.5.8: Blow ye the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah: cry aloud at Beth-aven, after thee, O Benjamin.
texts.hos.5.9: Ephraim shall be desolate in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which shall surely be.
texts.hos.5.10: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: therefore I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
texts.hos.5.11: Ephraim is oppressed and broken in judgment, because he willingly walked after the commandment.
texts.hos.5.12: Therefore will I be to Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.
texts.hos.5.13: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah saw his wound, then Ephraim went to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet he could not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.
texts.hos.5.14: For I will be to Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, even I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue him.
texts.hos.5.15: I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.
texts.hos.6.1: Come, and let us return to the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
texts.hos.6.2: After two days will he revive us: in the third day will he raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.
texts.hos.6.3: Then shall we know, if we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he will come to us as the rain, as the latter and former rain to the earth.
texts.hos.6.4: O Ephraim, what shall I do to thee? O Judah, what shall I do to thee? for your goodness is as the morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.
texts.hos.6.5: Therefore have I hewed them by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments are as the light that goeth forth.
texts.hos.6.6: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice: and the knowledge of God more than burnt-offerings.
texts.hos.6.7: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.
texts.hos.6.8: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity, and is polluted with blood.
texts.hos.6.9: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.
texts.hos.6.10: I have seen a horrible thing in the house of Israel: there is the prostitution of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
texts.hos.6.11: Also, O Judah, he hath set a harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.
texts.hos.7.1: When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was disclosed, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, and the troop of robbers strippeth without.
texts.hos.7.2: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them around; they are before my face.
texts.hos.7.3: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
texts.hos.7.4: They are all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, who ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it is leavened.
texts.hos.7.5: In the day of our king the princes have made him sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
texts.hos.7.6: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
texts.hos.7.7: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth to me.
texts.hos.7.8: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
texts.hos.7.9: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth it not: yes, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.
texts.hos.7.10: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the LORD their God, nor seek him for all this.
texts.hos.7.11: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
texts.hos.7.12: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.
texts.hos.7.13: Woe to them! for they have fled from me: destruction to them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
texts.hos.7.14: And they have not cried to me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, and they rebel against me.
texts.hos.7.15: Though I have bound and strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.
texts.hos.7.16: They return, but not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.
texts.hos.8.1: Set the trumpet to thy mouth. He shall come as an eagle against the house of the LORD, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.
texts.hos.8.2: Israel shall cry to me, My God, we know thee.
texts.hos.8.3: Israel hath cast off the thing that is good: the enemy shall pursue him.
texts.hos.8.4: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew it not: of their silver and their gold have they made for themselves idols, that they may be cut off.
texts.hos.8.5: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast thee off; my anger is kindled against them: how long will it be ere they attain to innocence?
texts.hos.8.6: For from Israel was it also: the workman made it; therefore it is not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
texts.hos.8.7: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if it shall yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
texts.hos.8.8: Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel in which is no pleasure.
texts.hos.8.9: For they have gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
texts.hos.8.10: Yes, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.
texts.hos.8.11: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be to him to sin.
texts.hos.8.12: I have written to him the great things of my law, but they were counted as a strange thing.
texts.hos.8.13: They sacrifice flesh for the sacrifices of my offerings, and eat it; but the LORD accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.
texts.hos.8.14: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fortified cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
texts.hos.9.1: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as other people: for thou hast apostatized from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every corn-floor.
texts.hos.9.2: The floor and the wine-press shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.
texts.hos.9.3: They shall not dwell in the LORD'S land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things in Assyria.
texts.hos.9.4: They shall not offer wine-offerings to the LORD, neither shall they be pleasing to him: their sacrifices shall be to them as the bread of mourners; all that eat of it shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the LORD.
texts.hos.9.5: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?
texts.hos.9.6: For lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant places for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns shall be in their tabernacles.
texts.hos.9.7: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompense are come; Israel shall know it: the prophet is a fool, the spiritual man is mad, for the multitude of thy iniquity, and the great hatred.
texts.hos.9.8: The watchman of Ephraim was with my God: but the prophet is a snare of a fowler in all his ways, and hatred in the house of his God.
texts.hos.9.9: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah: therefore he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
texts.hos.9.10: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the first ripe in the fig-tree at her first time: but they went to Baal-peor, and separated themselves to that shame; and their abominations were according as they loved.
texts.hos.9.11: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
texts.hos.9.12: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, that there shall not be a man left: yes, woe also to them when I depart from them!
texts.hos.9.13: Ephraim, as I saw Tyre, is planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
texts.hos.9.14: Give them, O LORD: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
texts.hos.9.15: All their wickedness is in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of my house, I will love them no more: all their princes are revolters.
texts.hos.9.16: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yes, though they bring forth, yet will I slay even the beloved fruit of their womb.
texts.hos.9.17: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken to him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
texts.hos.10.1: Israel is an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit to himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath multiplied the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
texts.hos.10.2: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
texts.hos.10.3: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the LORD; what then should a king do to us?
texts.hos.10.4: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
texts.hos.10.5: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Beth-aven: for its people shall mourn over it, and its priests that rejoiced on it, for its glory, because it is departed from it.
texts.hos.10.6: It shall also be carried to Assyria, for a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
texts.hos.10.7: As for Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.
texts.hos.10.8: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
texts.hos.10.9: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
texts.hos.10.10: It is in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
texts.hos.10.11: And Ephraim is as a heifer that is taught, and loveth to tread out the corn; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, and Jacob shall break his clods.
texts.hos.10.12: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek the LORD, till he shall come and reign righteousness upon you.
texts.hos.10.13: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou hast trusted in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
texts.hos.10.14: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be plundered, as Shalman plundered Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon her children.
texts.hos.10.15: So shall Beth-el do to you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel be utterly cut off.
texts.hos.11.1: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
texts.hos.11.2: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed to Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
texts.hos.11.3: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
texts.hos.11.4: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid food for them.
texts.hos.11.5: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.
texts.hos.11.6: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour them, because of their own counsels.
texts.hos.11.7: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt him.
texts.hos.11.8: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? how shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? how shall I set thee as Zeboim? my heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
texts.hos.11.9: I will not execute the fierceness of my anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.
texts.hos.11.10: They shall walk after the LORD: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.
texts.hos.11.11: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the LORD.
texts.hos.11.12: Ephraim encompasseth me with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.
texts.hos.12.1: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily multiplieth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.
texts.hos.12.2: The LORD hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.
texts.hos.12.3: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:
texts.hos.12.4: Yes, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication to him: he found him in Beth-el, and there he spoke with us;
texts.hos.12.5: Even the LORD God of hosts; the LORD is his memorial.
texts.hos.12.6: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.
texts.hos.12.7: He is a merchant, the balances of deceit are in his hand: he loveth to oppress.
texts.hos.12.8: And Ephraim said, Yet I have become rich, I have found for myself substance: in all my labors they shall find no iniquity in me that were sin.
texts.hos.12.9: And I that am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.
texts.hos.12.10: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes by the ministry of the prophets.
texts.hos.12.11: Is there iniquity in Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yes, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
texts.hos.12.12: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.
texts.hos.12.13: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
texts.hos.12.14: Ephraim provoked him to anger most bitterly: therefore will he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach will his Lord return to him.
texts.hos.13.1: When Ephraim spoke trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
texts.hos.13.2: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, and idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of artificers: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.
texts.hos.13.3: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff that is driven with the whirlwind from the floor, and as the smoke from the chimney.
texts.hos.13.4: Yet I am the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no God but me: for there is no savior besides me.
texts.hos.13.5: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drouth.
texts.hos.13.6: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.
texts.hos.13.7: Therefore I will be to them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe them.
texts.hos.13.8: I will meet them as a bear that is bereaved of her whelps, and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.
texts.hos.13.9: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me is thy help.
texts.hos.13.10: I will be thy king: where is any other that may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes?
texts.hos.13.11: I gave thee a king in my anger, and took him away in my wrath.
texts.hos.13.12: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is hid.
texts.hos.13.13: The sorrows of a travailing woman shall come upon him: he is an unwise son; for he should not stay long in the place of the breaking forth of children.
texts.hos.13.14: I will ransom them from the power of the grave; I will redeem them from death: O death, I will be thy plagues, O grave, I will be thy destruction: repentance shall be hid from my eyes.
texts.hos.13.15: Though he is fruitful among his brethren, an east wind shall come, the wind of the LORD shall come up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall pillage the treasure of all pleasant vessels.
texts.hos.13.16: Samaria shall become desolate; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword: their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
texts.hos.14.1: O Israel, return to the LORD thy God; for thou hast fallen by thy iniquity.
texts.hos.14.2: Take with you words, and turn to the LORD: say to him, Take away all iniquity, and receive us graciously: so will we render the calves of our lips.
texts.hos.14.3: Ashur shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, Ye are our gods: for in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
texts.hos.14.4: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely: for my anger is turned away from him.
texts.hos.14.5: I will be as the dew to Israel: he shall grow as the lily and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
texts.hos.14.6: His branches shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive-tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
texts.hos.14.7: They that dwell under his shade shall return; they shall revive as the corn, and grow as the vine: the scent of it shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
texts.hos.14.8: Ephraim shall say, What have I to do any more with idols? I have heard him, and observed him: I am like a green fir-tree. From me is thy fruit found.
texts.hos.14.9: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? prudent, and he shall know them? for the ways of the LORD are right, and the just shall walk in them: but the transgressors shall fall in them.

texts.hos.1.1: The word of Jehovah that came unto Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel.
texts.hos.1.2: The beginning of the word of Jehovah through Hosea. And Jehovah said to Hosea, Go, take unto thee a wife of whoredoms, and children of whoredoms; for the land is entirely given up to whoredom, away from Jehovah.
texts.hos.1.3: And he went and took Gomer the daughter of Diblaim; and she conceived and bore him a son.
texts.hos.1.4: And Jehovah said unto him, Call his name Jizreel; for yet a little, and I will visit the blood of Jizreel upon the house of Jehu, and will cause the kingdom of the house of Israel to cease.
texts.hos.1.5: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jizreel.
texts.hos.1.6: And she conceived again, and bore a daughter. And he said unto him, Call her name Lo-ruhamah; for I will no more have mercy upon the house of Israel, so that I should pardon them.
texts.hos.1.7: But I will have mercy upon the house of Judah, and will save them by Jehovah their God; and I will not save them by bow, or by sword, or by battle, [or] by horses, or by horsemen.
texts.hos.1.8: And she weaned Lo-ruhamah; and she conceived and bore a son;
texts.hos.1.9: and he said, Call his name Lo-ammi; for ye are not my people, and I will not be for you.
texts.hos.1.10: Yet the number of the children of Israel shall be as the sand of the sea which cannot be measured or numbered; and it shall come to pass, [that] in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, it shall be said unto them, Sons of the living ùGod.
texts.hos.1.11: And the children of Judah and the children of Israel shall be gathered together, and they shall appoint themselves one head, and shall go up out of the land: for great is the day of Jizreel.
texts.hos.2.1: Say unto your brethren Ammi; and to your sisters, Ruhamah.
texts.hos.2.2: Plead with your mother, plead; for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband: and let her put away her whoredoms from her face, and her adulteries from between her breasts;
texts.hos.2.3: lest I strip her naked, and set her as in the day that she was born, and make her as a wilderness, and set her as a dry land, and slay her with thirst.
texts.hos.2.4: And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they are the children of whoredoms.
texts.hos.2.5: For their mother hath played the harlot; she that conceived them hath done shamefully: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give [me] my bread and my water, my wool and my flax, mine oil and my drink.
texts.hos.2.6: Therefore behold, I will hedge up thy way with thorns; and I will fence [her] in with a wall, that she shall not find her paths.
texts.hos.2.7: And she shall pursue after her lovers, and shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, and shall not find them: and she shall say, I will go and return to my first husband, for then was it better with me than now.
texts.hos.2.8: And she did not know that I had given her the corn and the new wine and the oil, and had multiplied to her the silver and gold, which they employed for Baal.
texts.hos.2.9: Therefore will I return, and take away my corn in the time thereof, and my new wine in its season, and will withdraw my wool and my flax which should have covered her nakedness.
texts.hos.2.10: And now will I discover her impiety in the sight of her lovers, and none shall deliver her out of my hand.
texts.hos.2.11: And I will cause all her mirth to cease: her feasts, her new moons, and her sabbaths! and all her solemnities.
texts.hos.2.12: And I will make desolate her vine and her fig-tree, whereof she hath said, These are my rewards which my lovers have given me; and I will make them a forest, and the beasts of the field shall eat them.
texts.hos.2.13: And I will visit upon her the days of the Baals, wherein she burned incense to them, and decked herself with her rings and jewels, and went after her lovers, and forgot me, saith Jehovah.
texts.hos.2.14: Therefore behold, I will allure her, and bring her into the wilderness, and speak to her heart.
texts.hos.2.15: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
texts.hos.2.16: And it shall be in that day, saith Jehovah, [that] thou shalt call me, My husband, and shalt call me no more, Baali;
texts.hos.2.17: for I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and they shall no more be remembered by their name.
texts.hos.2.18: And I will make a covenant for them in that day with the beasts of the field, and with the fowl of the heavens, and the creeping things of the ground; and I will break bow and sword and battle out of the land; and I will make them to lie down safely.
texts.hos.2.19: And I will betroth thee unto me for ever; and I will betroth thee unto me in righteousness, and in judgment, and in loving-kindness, and in mercies;
texts.hos.2.20: and I will betroth thee unto me in faithfulness: and thou shalt know Jehovah.
texts.hos.2.21: And it shall come to pass in that day, I will hear, saith Jehovah, I will hear the heavens, and they shall hear the earth;
texts.hos.2.22: and the earth shall hear the corn, and the new wine, and the oil; and they shall hear Jizreel.
texts.hos.2.23: And I will sow her unto me in the land; and I will have mercy upon Lo-ruhamah; and I will say to Lo-ammi, Thou art my people; and they shall say, My God.
texts.hos.3.1: And Jehovah said unto me, Go again, love a woman beloved of a friend, and an adulteress, according to the love of Jehovah for the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love raisin-cakes.
texts.hos.3.2: So I bought her to me for fifteen silver [pieces], and for a homer of barley, and a half-homer of barley.
texts.hos.3.3: And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be [another] man's, and I will also be for thee.
texts.hos.3.4: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without king, and without prince, and without sacrifice, and without statue, and without ephod and teraphim.
texts.hos.3.5: Afterwards shall the children of Israel return, and seek Jehovah their God, and David their king; and shall turn with fear toward Jehovah and toward his goodness, at the end of the days.
texts.hos.4.1: Hear the word of Jehovah, ye children of Israel; for Jehovah hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land; for there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of God in the land.
texts.hos.4.2: Swearing, and lying, and killing, and stealing, and committing adultery, -- they break out; and blood toucheth blood.
texts.hos.4.3: For this shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowl of the heavens, yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.
texts.hos.4.4: Yet let no man strive, and let no man reprove; for thy people are as they that strive with the priest.
texts.hos.4.5: And thou shalt stumble by day; and the prophet also shall stumble with thee by night: and I will destroy thy mother.
texts.hos.4.6: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge; for thou hast rejected knowledge, and I will reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me; seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I also will forget thy children.
texts.hos.4.7: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me: I will change their glory into shame.
texts.hos.4.8: They eat the sin of my people, and their soul longeth for their iniquity.
texts.hos.4.9: And it shall be as the people so the priest; and I will visit their ways upon them, and recompense to them their doings;
texts.hos.4.10: and they shall eat, and not have enough; they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: for they have left off taking heed to Jehovah.
texts.hos.4.11: Fornication, and wine, and new wine take away the heart.
texts.hos.4.12: My people ask counsel of their stock, and their staff declareth unto them; for the spirit of whoredoms causeth [them] to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God:
texts.hos.4.13: they sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oak and poplar and terebinth, because the shade thereof is good; therefore your daughters play the harlot and your daughters-in-law commit adultery.
texts.hos.4.14: I will not punish your daughters when they play the harlot, nor your daughters-in-law for their committing adultery; for they themselves go aside with harlots, and they sacrifice with prostitutes: and the people that doth not understand shall come to ruin.
texts.hos.4.15: Though thou, Israel, play the harlot, let not Judah trespass; and come ye not unto Gilgal, neither go up to Beth-aven, nor swear [As] Jehovah liveth!
texts.hos.4.16: For Israel is refractory as an untractable heifer; now will Jehovah feed them as a lamb in a wide [pasture].
texts.hos.4.17: -- Ephraim is joined to idols: leave him alone.
texts.hos.4.18: Their drink is sour; they give themselves up to whoredom; her great men passionately love [their] shame.
texts.hos.4.19: The wind hath wrapped her up in its wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their sacrifices.
texts.hos.5.1: Hear this, ye priests; and hearken, ye house of Israel; and give ear, O house of the king: for this judgment is for you; for ye have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread upon Tabor.
texts.hos.5.2: And they have plunged themselves in the corruption of apostasy, but I will be a chastiser of them all.
texts.hos.5.3: I know Ephraim, and Israel is not hid from me; for now, Ephraim, thou hast committed whoredom; Israel is defiled.
texts.hos.5.4: Their doings do not allow them to return unto their God; for the spirit of whoredoms is in the midst of them, and they know not Jehovah.
texts.hos.5.5: And Israel's pride doth testify to his face; and Israel and Ephraim shall fall by their iniquity: Judah also shall fall with them.
texts.hos.5.6: They shall go with their flocks and with their herds to seek Jehovah; but they shall not find [him]: he hath withdrawn himself from them.
texts.hos.5.7: They have dealt treacherously against Jehovah; for they have begotten strange children: now shall the new moon devour them, with their allotted possessions.
texts.hos.5.8: Blow the horn in Gibeah, the trumpet in Ramah; cry aloud [at] Beth-aven: behind thee, O Benjamin!
texts.hos.5.9: Ephraim shall be a desolation in the day of rebuke: among the tribes of Israel have I made known that which is sure.
texts.hos.5.10: The princes of Judah are become like them that remove the landmark: I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.
texts.hos.5.11: Ephraim is oppressed, crushed in judgment, because in selfwill he walked after the commandment [of man].
texts.hos.5.12: And I will be unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.
texts.hos.5.13: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah his sore, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb; but he was unable to heal you, nor hath he removed your sore.
texts.hos.5.14: For I will be unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah. I, I will tear and go away; I will carry off, and there shall be none to deliver.
texts.hos.5.15: I will go away, I will return to my place, till they acknowledge their trespass, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.
texts.hos.6.1: Come and let us return unto Jehovah: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.
texts.hos.6.2: After two days will he revive us; on the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live before his face;
texts.hos.6.3: and we shall know, -- we shall follow on to know Jehovah: his going forth is assured as the morning dawn; and he will come unto us as the rain, as the latter rain which watereth the earth.
texts.hos.6.4: What shall I do unto thee, Ephraim? What shall I do unto thee, Judah? For your goodness is as a morning cloud, and as the dew that early passeth away.
texts.hos.6.5: Therefore have I hewed [them] by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and my judgment goeth forth as the light.
texts.hos.6.6: For I delight in loving-kindness, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt-offerings.
texts.hos.6.7: But they like Adam have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.
texts.hos.6.8: Gilead is a city of them that work iniquity; it is tracked with blood.
texts.hos.6.9: And as troops of robbers lie in wait for a man, so the company of priests murder in the way of Shechem; yea, they commit lewdness.
texts.hos.6.10: In the house of Israel have I seen a horrible thing: the whoredom of Ephraim is there; Israel is defiled.
texts.hos.6.11: Also, for thee, Judah, is a harvest appointed, when I shall turn again the captivity of my people.
texts.hos.7.1: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim is discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they practise falsehood; and the thief entereth in, [and] the troop of robbers assaileth without.
texts.hos.7.2: And they say not in their hearts [that] I remember all their wickedness: now do their own doings encompass them; they are before my face.
texts.hos.7.3: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
texts.hos.7.4: They all practise adultery, as an oven heated by the baker: he ceaseth from stirring [the fire] after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
texts.hos.7.5: In the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine: he stretched out his hand to scorners.
texts.hos.7.6: For they have applied their heart like an oven to their lying in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth like a flaming fire.
texts.hos.7.7: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges; all their kings are fallen: there is none among them that calleth unto me.
texts.hos.7.8: Ephraim, he mixeth himself with the peoples; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
texts.hos.7.9: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth [it] not; yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, and he knoweth [it] not.
texts.hos.7.10: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face; and they do not return to Jehovah their God, nor seek him for all this.
texts.hos.7.11: And Ephraim is become like a silly dove without understanding: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
texts.hos.7.12: When they go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowl of the heavens; I will chastise them, according as their assembly hath heard.
texts.hos.7.13: Woe unto them! for they have wandered from me; destruction unto them! for they have transgressed against me. And I would redeem them; but they speak lies against me.
texts.hos.7.14: And they cried not unto me in their heart, when they howled upon their beds; they assemble themselves for corn and new wine; they have turned aside from me.
texts.hos.7.15: I have indeed trained, I have strengthened their arms, but they imagine mischief against me.
texts.hos.7.16: They return, [but] not to the [Most] High: they are like a deceitful bow. Their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this shall be their derision in the land of Egypt.
texts.hos.8.1: Set the trumpet to thy mouth. [He cometh] as an eagle against the house of Jehovah, because they have transgressed my covenant, and rebelled against my law.
texts.hos.8.2: They shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee; [we], Israel.
texts.hos.8.3: Israel hath cast off good: the enemy shall pursue him.
texts.hos.8.4: They have set up kings, but not by me; they have made princes, and I knew it not; of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
texts.hos.8.5: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast [thee] off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long will they be incapable of purity?
texts.hos.8.6: For from Israel is this also: -- a workman made it, and it is no God: for the calf of Samaria shall be [broken in] pieces.
texts.hos.8.7: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk; should it sprout, it would yield no meal; if so be it yield, strangers shall swallow it up.
texts.hos.8.8: Israel is swallowed up: now are they become among the nations as a vessel wherein is no pleasure.
texts.hos.8.9: For they are gone up [to] Assyria [as] a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
texts.hos.8.10: Although they hire among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall begin to be straitened under the burden of the king of princes.
texts.hos.8.11: Because Ephraim hath multiplied altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.
texts.hos.8.12: I have prescribed unto him the manifold things of my law: they are counted [as] a strange thing.
texts.hos.8.13: They sacrifice flesh [for] the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat it; Jehovah hath no delight in them. Now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.
texts.hos.8.14: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
texts.hos.9.1: Rejoice not, Israel, exultingly, as the peoples; for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved harlot's hire upon every corn-floor.
texts.hos.9.2: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail her.
texts.hos.9.3: They shall not dwell in Jehovah's land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and in Assyria shall they eat that which is unclean.
texts.hos.9.4: They shall pour out no [offerings of] wine to Jehovah, neither shall their sacrifices be pleasing unto him: they shall be unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be defiled: for their bread shall be for themselves; it shall not come into the house of Jehovah.
texts.hos.9.5: What will ye do in the day of assembly, and in the day of the feast of Jehovah?
texts.hos.9.6: For behold, they are gone away because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Moph shall bury them: their pleasant things of silver, nettles shall possess them; thorns shall be in their tents.
texts.hos.9.7: The days of visitation are come; the days of recompence are come: Israel shall know [it]: the prophet is a fool, the inspired man is mad, because of the greatness of thine iniquity, and the great enmity.
texts.hos.9.8: Is Ephraim a watchman with my God? [nay] the prophet is a fowler's snare on all his ways, enmity in the house of his God.
texts.hos.9.9: They have deeply corrupted themselves as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
texts.hos.9.10: I found Israel as grapes in the wilderness; as first-ripe fruit on the fig-tree, I saw your fathers at the beginning: they went to Baal-Peor, and separated themselves unto that shame, and became abominations like their lover.
texts.hos.9.11: As for Ephraim, their glory shall fly away as a bird, -- no birth, no pregnancy, no conception!
texts.hos.9.12: For even should they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, [that] not a man [remain]: for woe also to them when I shall have departed from them!
texts.hos.9.13: Ephraim, as I saw [him], was a Tyre planted in a beautiful place; but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the slayer.
texts.hos.9.14: Give them, Jehovah -- what wilt thou give? -- give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
texts.hos.9.15: All their wickedness is in Gilgal; for there I hated them: because of the wickedness of their doings, I will drive them out of my house, I will love them no more: all their princes are rebellious.
texts.hos.9.16: Ephraim is smitten: their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit; yea, though they should bring forth, yet will I slay the beloved [fruit] of their womb.
texts.hos.9.17: My God hath rejected them, because they hearkened not unto him; and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
texts.hos.10.1: Israel is an unpruned vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the abundance of his fruit he hath multiplied altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly statues.
texts.hos.10.2: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found guilty: he will break down their altars, he will destroy their statues.
texts.hos.10.3: For now they will say, We have no king, for we feared not Jehovah; and a king, what can he do for us?
texts.hos.10.4: They speak [mere] words, swearing falsely in making a covenant; therefore shall judgment spring up as hemlock in the furrows of the fields.
texts.hos.10.5: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calf of Beth-aven; for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the idolatrous priests thereof shall tremble for it, for its glory, because it is departed from it.
texts.hos.10.6: Yea, it shall be carried unto Assyria [as] a present for king Jareb: Ephraim shall be seized with shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
texts.hos.10.7: As for Samaria her king is cut off as chips upon the face of the waters.
texts.hos.10.8: And the high places of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up upon their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us! and to the hills, Fall on us!
texts.hos.10.9: From the days of Gibeah hast thou sinned, O Israel: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
texts.hos.10.10: At my pleasure will I chastise them; and the peoples shall be assembled against them, when they are bound for their two iniquities.
texts.hos.10.11: And Ephraim is a trained heifer, that loveth to tread out [the corn]; I have passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to draw; Judah shall plough, Jacob shall break his clods.
texts.hos.10.12: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to mercy; break up your fallow ground: for it is time to seek Jehovah, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
texts.hos.10.13: Ye have ploughed wickedness, reaped iniquity, eaten the fruit of lies; for thou didst confide in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
texts.hos.10.14: And a tumult shall arise among thy peoples, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Beth-arbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces with the children.
texts.hos.10.15: So shall Bethel do unto you because of the wickedness of your wickedness: at day-break shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
texts.hos.11.1: When Israel was a child, then I loved him, and out of Egypt I called my son.
texts.hos.11.2: As they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto the Baals, and burned incense to graven images.
texts.hos.11.3: And I it was that taught Ephraim to walk, -- He took them upon his arms, -- but they knew not that I healed them.
texts.hos.11.4: I drew them with bands of a man, with cords of love; and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I gently caused them to eat.
texts.hos.11.5: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king; for they refused to return [to me];
texts.hos.11.6: and the sword shall turn about in his cities, and shall consume his bars, and devour [them], because of their own counsels.
texts.hos.11.7: Yea, my people are bent upon backsliding from me: though they call them to the Most High, none at all exalteth [him].
texts.hos.11.8: How shall I give thee over, Ephraim? [how] shall I deliver thee up, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? [how] shall I set thee as Zeboim? My heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
texts.hos.11.9: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not again destroy Ephraim; for I am ùGod, and not man, -- the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not come in anger.
texts.hos.11.10: They shall walk after Jehovah; he shall roar like a lion; when he shall roar, then the children shall hasten from the west:
texts.hos.11.11: they shall hasten as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria; and I will cause them to dwell in their houses, saith Jehovah.
texts.hos.11.12: Ephraim encompasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit; but Judah yet walketh with ùGod, and with the holy things of truth.
texts.hos.12.1: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and pursueth after the east wind: all day long he multiplieth lies and desolation; and they make a covenant with Assyria, and oil is carried into Egypt.
texts.hos.12.2: Jehovah hath also a controversy with Judah, and he will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.
texts.hos.12.3: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and in his strength he wrestled with God.
texts.hos.12.4: Yea, he wrestled with the Angel, and prevailed; he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him in Bethel, and there he spoke with us,
texts.hos.12.5: -- even Jehovah, the God of hosts, -- Jehovah is his memorial.
texts.hos.12.6: And thou, return unto thy God: keep loving-kindness and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.
texts.hos.12.7: [He is] a merchant, balances of deceit are in his hand; he loveth to oppress.
texts.hos.12.8: And Ephraim saith, Nevertheless I am become rich, I have found me out substance; in all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that were sin.
texts.hos.12.9: But I [that am] Jehovah thy God from the land of Egypt will again make thee to dwell in tents, as in the days of the solemn feast.
texts.hos.12.10: And I have spoken to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and by means of the prophets have I used similitudes.
texts.hos.12.11: If Gilead is iniquity, surely they are but vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars are as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
texts.hos.12.12: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept [sheep].
texts.hos.12.13: And by a prophet Jehovah brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
texts.hos.12.14: Ephraim provoked [him] to anger most bitterly; and his Lord shall leave his blood upon him, and recompense unto him his reproach.
texts.hos.13.1: When Ephraim spoke, there was trembling; he exalted himself in Israel: but he trespassed through Baal, and he died.
texts.hos.13.2: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.
texts.hos.13.3: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff driven with the whirlwind out of the threshing-floor, and as the smoke out of the lattice.
texts.hos.13.4: Yet I [am] Jehovah thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou hast known no God but me; and there is no saviour besides me.
texts.hos.13.5: I knew thee in the wilderness, in the land of drought.
texts.hos.13.6: According to their pasture, they became full; they became full, and their heart was exalted: therefore have they forgotten me.
texts.hos.13.7: And I will be unto them as a lion; as a leopard I will lurk for them by the way;
texts.hos.13.8: I will meet them as a bear bereaved of her [whelps], and will rend the covering of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lioness: the beast of the field shall tear them.
texts.hos.13.9: It is thy destruction, O Israel, that [thou art] against me, against thy help.
texts.hos.13.10: Where then is thy king, that he may save thee in all thy cities? and thy judges of whom thou saidst, Give me a king and princes? --
texts.hos.13.11: I gave thee a king in mine anger, and took him away in my wrath.
texts.hos.13.12: The iniquity of Ephraim is bound up; his sin is laid by in store.
texts.hos.13.13: The pangs of a woman in travail shall come upon him: he is a son not wise; for at the time of the breaking forth of children, he was not there.
texts.hos.13.14: I will ransom them from the power of Sheol. I will redeem them from death: where, O death, are thy plagues? where, O Sheol, is thy destruction? Repentance shall be hid from mine eyes.
texts.hos.13.15: Though he be fruitful among [his] brethren, an east wind shall come, a wind of Jehovah [that] cometh up from the wilderness, and his spring shall become dry, and his fountain shall be dried up: he shall spoil the treasure of all pleasant vessels.
texts.hos.13.16: Samaria shall bear her guilt; for she hath rebelled against her God: they shall fall by the sword; their infants shall be dashed in pieces, and their women with child shall be ripped up.
texts.hos.14.1: O Israel, return unto Jehovah thy God; for thou hast fallen by thine iniquity.
texts.hos.14.2: Take with you words, and turn to Jehovah; say unto him, Forgive all iniquity, and receive [us] graciously; so will we render the calves of our lips.
texts.hos.14.3: Assyria shall not save us; we will not ride upon horses: neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, [Thou art] our God; because in thee the fatherless findeth mercy.
texts.hos.14.4: I will heal their backsliding, I will love them freely; for mine anger is turned away from him.
texts.hos.14.5: I will be as the dew unto Israel: he shall blossom as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Lebanon.
texts.hos.14.6: His shoots shall spread, and his beauty shall be as the olive-tree, and his smell as Lebanon.
texts.hos.14.7: They shall return and sit under his shadow; they shall revive [as] corn, and blossom as the vine: the renown thereof shall be as the wine of Lebanon.
texts.hos.14.8: Ephraim [shall say], What have I to do any more with idols? (I answer [him], and I will observe him.) I am like a green fir-tree. -- From me is thy fruit found.
texts.hos.14.9: Who is wise, and he shall understand these things? intelligent, and he shall know them? For the ways of Jehovah are right, and the just shall walk in them; but the transgressors shall fall therein.

texts.hos.1.1: A word of Jehovah that hath been unto Hosea, son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam son of Joash, king of Israel:
texts.hos.1.2: The commencement of Jehovah's speaking by Hosea. And Jehovah saith unto Hosea, `Go, take to thee a woman of whoredoms, and children of whoredoms, for utterly go a-whoring doth the land from after Jehovah.'
texts.hos.1.3: And he goeth and taketh Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceiveth and beareth to him a son;
texts.hos.1.4: and Jehovah saith unto him, `Call his name Jezreel, for yet a little, and I have charged the blood of Jezreel on the house of Jehu, and have caused to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel;
texts.hos.1.5: and it hath come to pass in that day that I have broken the bow of Israel, in the valley of Jezreel.'
texts.hos.1.6: And she conceiveth again, and beareth a daughter, and He saith to him, `Call her name Lo-Ruhamah, for I add no more to pity the house of Israel, for I do utterly take them away;
texts.hos.1.7: and the house of Judah I pity, and have saved them by Jehovah their God, and do not save them by bow, and by sword, and by battle, by horses, and by horsemen.'
texts.hos.1.8: And she weaneth Lo-Ruhamah, and conceiveth, and beareth a son;
texts.hos.1.9: and He saith, `Call his name Lo-Ammi, for ye [are] not My people, and I am not for you;
texts.hos.1.10: and the number of the sons of Israel hath been as the sand of the sea, that is not measured nor numbered, and it hath come to pass in the place where it is said to them, Ye [are] not My people, it is said to them, Sons of the Living God;
texts.hos.1.11: and gathered have been the sons of Judah and the sons of Israel together, and they have appointed to themselves one head, and have gone up from the land, for great [is] the day of Jezreel.
texts.hos.2.1: `Say ye to your brethren -- Ammi, And to your sisters -- Ruhamah.
texts.hos.2.2: Plead ye with your mother -- plead, (For she [is] not My wife, and I [am] not her husband,) And she turneth her whoredoms from before her, And her adulteries from between her breasts,
texts.hos.2.3: Lest I strip her naked. And have set her up as [in] the day of her birth, And have made her as a wilderness, And have set her as a dry land, And have put her to death with thirst.
texts.hos.2.4: And her sons I do not pity, For sons of whoredoms [are] they,
texts.hos.2.5: For gone a-whoring hath their mother, Acted shamefully hath their conceiver, For she hath said, I go after my lovers, Those giving my bread and my water, My wool and my flax, my oil and my drink.
texts.hos.2.6: Therefore, lo, I am hedging up thy way with thorns, And I have made for her a wall, And her paths she doth not find.
texts.hos.2.7: And she hath pursued her lovers, And she doth not overtake them, And hath sought them, and doth not find, And she hath said: I go, and I turn back unto My first husband, For -- better to me then than now.
texts.hos.2.8: And she knew not that I had given to her, The corn, and the new wine, and the oil. Yea, silver I did multiply to her, And the gold they prepared for Baal.
texts.hos.2.9: Therefore do I turn back, And I have taken My corn in its season, And My new wine in its appointed time, And I have taken away My wool and My flax, covering her nakedness.
texts.hos.2.10: And now do I reveal her dishonour before the eyes of her lovers, And none doth deliver her out of My hand.
texts.hos.2.11: And I have caused to cease all her joy, Her festival, her new moon, and her sabbath, Even all her appointed times,
texts.hos.2.12: And made desolate her vine and her fig-tree, Of which she said, A gift they [are] to me, That my lovers have given to me, And I have made them for a forest, And consumed them hath a beast of the field.
texts.hos.2.13: And I have charged on her the days of the Baalim, To whom she maketh perfume, And putteth on her ring and her ornament, And goeth after her lovers, And Me forgat -- an affirmation of Jehovah.
texts.hos.2.14: Therefore, lo, I am enticing her, And have caused her to go to the wilderness, And I have spoken unto her heart,
texts.hos.2.15: And given to her her vineyards from thence, And the valley of Achor for an opening of hope, And she hath responded there as in the days of her youth, And as in the day of her coming up out of the land of Egypt.
texts.hos.2.16: And it hath come to pass, in that day, An affirmation of Jehovah, Thou dost call Me -- My husband, And dost not call Me any more -- My lord.
texts.hos.2.17: And I have turned aside the names of the lords from her mouth, And they are not remembered any more by their name.
texts.hos.2.18: And I have made to them a covenant in that day, with the beast of the field, And with the fowl of the heavens, And the creeping thing of the ground, And bow, and sword, and war I break from off the land, And have caused them to lie down confidently.
texts.hos.2.19: And I have betrothed thee to Me to the age, And betrothed thee to Me in righteousness, And in judgment, and kindness, and mercies,
texts.hos.2.20: And betrothed thee to Me in faithfulness, And thou hast known Jehovah.
texts.hos.2.21: And it hath come to pass in that day, I answer -- an affirmation of Jehovah, I answer the heavens, and they answer the earth.
texts.hos.2.22: And the earth doth answer the corn, And the new wine, and the oil, And they answer Jezreel.
texts.hos.2.23: And I have sowed her to Me in the land, And I have pitied Lo-Ruhamah, And I have said to Lo-Ammi, My people thou [art], and it saith, My God!'
texts.hos.3.1: And Jehovah saith unto me: `Again, go, love a woman, loved of a friend, and an adulteress, like the loved of Jehovah, the sons of Israel, and they are turning unto other gods, and are lovers of grape-cakes.'
texts.hos.3.2: And I buy her to me for fifteen silverlings, and a homer and a letech of barley;
texts.hos.3.3: and I say unto her, `Many days thou dost remain for Me, thou dost not go a-whoring, nor become any one's; and I also [am] for thee.'
texts.hos.3.4: For many days remain do the sons of Israel without a king, and there is no prince, and there is no sacrifice, and there is no standing pillar, and there is no ephod and teraphim.
texts.hos.3.5: Afterwards turned back have the sons of Israel, and sought Jehovah their God, and David their king, and have hastened unto Jehovah, and unto His goodness, in the latter end of the days.
texts.hos.4.1: `Hear a word of Jehovah, sons of Israel, For a strife [is] to Jehovah with inhabitants of the land, For there is no truth, nor kindness, Nor knowledge of God, in the land,
texts.hos.4.2: Swearing, and lying, and murdering, And stealing, and committing adultery -- have increased, And blood against blood hath touched.
texts.hos.4.3: Therefore mourn doth the land, And weak is every dweller in it, With the beast of the field, And with the fowl of the heavens, And the fishes of the sea -- they are removed.
texts.hos.4.4: Only, let no one strive, nor reprove a man, And thy people [are] as those striving with a priest.
texts.hos.4.5: And thou hast stumbled in the day, And stumbled hath also a prophet with thee in the night, And I have cut off thy mother.
texts.hos.4.6: Cut off have been My people for lack of knowledge, Because thou knowledge hast rejected, I reject thee from being priest to Me, And thou forgettest the law of thy God, I forget thy sons, I also!
texts.hos.4.7: According to their abundance so they sinned against Me, Their honour into shame I change.
texts.hos.4.8: The sin of My people they do eat, And unto their iniquity lift up their soul.
texts.hos.4.9: And it hath been, like people, like priest, And I have charged on it its ways, And its habitual doings I return to it.
texts.hos.4.10: And they have eaten, and are not satisfied, They have gone a-whoring, and increase not, For they have left off taking heed to Jehovah.
texts.hos.4.11: Whoredom, and wine, and new wine, take the heart,
